snippet.title: Sobakistan: The Land of Dogs - ''90% ready'' Trailer
snippet.description:
The game is 90% ready! New playtest: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3742720/Sobakistan_The_Land_of_Dogs/
The save system is working, the minigame issues have been fixed, and all the boring stuff is gone. Now there’s only fun left. As much as that's possible in Sobakistan.
